summary: Decision Logic is a back-office restaurant management platform providing real-time P&L, inventory/food-cost management, labor scheduling, and AI-assisted ordering for multi-location restaurant operators.
Keegan Conrey is Decision Logic's CEO, quoted in an August 2026 partnership announcement with CBS NorthStar.

An earlier vendor case study (Aviture, publication date not stated but internal references place it around 2020-2021) names Mandi Wooledge as President/COO and Jim Barber and John Barber as co-founders of Decision Logic. (Scope note: Undated case study; leadership roles may have changed by the time of the 2026 CBS NorthStar announcement, which names a different CEO (Keegan Conrey).)

Decision Logic's August 2026 partnership announcement with CBS NorthStar names 54th Street Restaurants, RibCrib BBQ, Golden Corral, Taco John's, and Twin Peaks among restaurant brands referenced in connection with the two platforms. (Scope note: Release lists these brands in connection with the two companies' combined customer base; it does not explicitly state each named brand uses both platforms together.)

On August 18, 2026, CBS NorthStar (a POS/restaurant management platform) announced an integration partnership with Decision Logic to give multi-unit operators unified access to POS and back-of-house operational data.
